script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. MAIN STREET - DAY

A bustling small-town main street. People go about their day, chatting, laughing, browsing shops. A town crier, wearing a colorful coat and holding a wooden megaphone, stands in the town square.

TOWN CRIER
(shouting)
Hear ye, hear ye! The monthly market begins at midday. Come one, come all!

INT. CAFE - DAY

Two friends, SAM (late 20s, quirky, optimistic) and HANNAH (late 20s, pragmatic, quick-witted), sit at a table in a cozy cafe.

SAM
(excitedly)
Hannah, you won't believe it! The town council approved my proposal for a community garden.

HANNAH
(sarcastically)
Wow, Sam. That's fantastic. I'm sure it'll bring in plenty of business for your flower shop.

Sam smiles, unfazed by Hannah's teasing.

SAM
Yes, but it'll also be a wonderful addition to our small town. And who knows, maybe it'll bring out some hidden talents in our fellow residents.

INT. TOWN HALL - DAY

Sam and Hannah enter the town hall. Inside, they find Mayor MORRIS (50s, stern, fair) presiding over a meeting.

MAYOR MORRIS
(looking up)
Ah, Sam and Hannah. You're here for the town council meeting? Take a seat.

INT. TOWN COUNCIL CHAMBERS - DAY

The council members discuss various issues concerning the town. Sam proposes the community garden, which is met with skepticism.

COUNCIL MEMBER 1
This is a wonderful idea, Sam, but we don't have the resources to maintain it.

Suddenly, a young man, JACK (early 30s, shy, earnest), timidly steps forward.

JACK
Mayor Morris, I'd be happy to help with the garden. I've always loved gardening, and I'd be glad to donate my time and energy to make it a success.

INT. CAFE - NIGHT

Sam and Hannah sit at the same table, laughing as they recall the town council meeting.

SAM
Can you believe Jack volunteered to help with the garden? I think we've got a real winner here.

HANNAH
(smiling)
Yes, and it's nice to see the community coming together for something positive.

INT. TOWN SQUARE - DAY

The monthly market is in full swing. Sam, Hannah, and Jack work together to set up the community garden, greeted with encouragement and support from the townspeople.

INT. CAFE - NIGHT

Sam and Hannah sit at the table, tired but satisfied.

SAM
Another successful market. And the garden looks amazing, thanks to Jack.

HANNAH
It really does. I'm glad we could make this happen for our town.

INT. GARDEN - DAY

The community garden is in full bloom. Sam, Hannah, and Jack work side by side, planting flowers, tending to vegetables, and chatting with other townspeople.

COUNCIL MEMBER 2
(approaching)
Sam, I must admit, I was skeptical about this community garden idea, but it's really taken off. I'm proud of all of us for coming together and making it a success.

Sam, Hannah, and Jack smile, knowing they've made a positive impact on their small town.

FADE OUT.

THE END
